title: Who this helps
metaDescription: How Patricia Smith at Equilibrium in Takaka, Golden Bay, NZ supports food intolerances, adrenal fatigue, migraines, and metabolic balance with kinesiology and nutrition.

blocks.html: At Equilibrium in Takaka, Golden Bay, New Zealand, Patricia Smith combines Touch for Health Kinesiology and Nutrition. Clients often arrive with a specific question — not a generic wellness browse. These pages describe how she works with the concerns people actually bring.

items: Food intolerances — muscle testing to identify intolerances and suitable supplements
Adrenal fatigue — kinesiology and nutrition when energy and stress feel stuck
Migraines and energy — practical nutrition pathways for migraines and low energy
Metabolic balance — food-led support for metabolic and post-menopause balance

blocks.html: Sessions are available at Golden Bay Organics (47 Commercial Street, Takaka) or by private arrangement, including online. Start with a free 15-minute Discovery call, or book a session at /bookings/. Phone 021 991 989.
Learn more about Touch for Health Kinesiology and Patricia’s nutrition approach.
